'''AR-X9 Prototype Droid''' was a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to guard the [[Olaris Spaceport]] in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The droid was armed with a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] and a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. During the siege of [[Olaris]] by the Imperial forces in [[3642 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was activated and engaged the intruders, but was eventually destroyed.
